text:
In this era we said "the 118th congress" most, 36 of us at peak on 2023-01-07, though the phrase first entered the record in 2021, from Rick Larsen. On the same day, 30 of us said "speaker of the house," first logged in 2013 from Robert B. Aderholt.

Later, 22 of us converged on "strategic production response act," first said 2023-01-12 by Richard Hudson; 20 of us said "the strategic production response act," and 21 said "strategic petroleum reserve," all peaking 2023-01-27.

On 2023-01-09, 21 of us each said "the family and small business taxpayer," "family and small business taxpayer protection," and "and small business taxpayer protection act," first entered that day by Adrian Smith.

We record that we arrived at these same words on the same days. That is what the record shows.
